name: Mage Ward
desc: Like the Wards that preserve the Arks on a smaller scale. A Mage's Ward offers simple physical insulation from potential harm by erecting a wall of thickened air. Few venture far without the Infused…

name: Terra Magna Magia
desc: A more ostentatious Magical work than a Circle, this enclosure of space designates a single Soul, drawing power from other Mages to feed their own.

name: Crystal Sphere
desc: Protection for longer periods of time for a larger group than a traditional Ward. Crystal Spheres are common tools for Mage Expeditioners spending a night on a Shard.

name: The Door in the Eye
desc: The past is inaccessible, time a wall over which none can climb. The Door in the Eye is a way through it.

name: Missile Array
desc: Intangible machinery able to focus Aether into bolts of pure energy. Arrays like these are a mainstay of practical Mages. While limited in scope, their strength comes from their reliability.
